8o Quid? In altero, in Arnobio, num me-lius Iesuitæ res succedit? Pejus. Nam Arnobius libro primo contra Gentes, Venerabar, inquit, o caecitas, nuper simulacra modo ex fornacibus prompta, in incudibus Deos, & ex malleis fabricatos. Et infrà: Tanquam inesset vis præsens, edulabar, affabar, & beneficia poscebam. Et infrà: Deos esse credebam ligna, lapides, offa, aut in huiusmodi rerum habitare materia. page.notes: Marginal note letters are read from superscript marks in the text. The Greek note is partly worn and read with doubt (marked [?]). "fan&.lib.2." and "bibioth." are uncertain abbreviations. "implctum" is printed without a vowel and is copied as printed. The word "la-" at the foot continues on the next page. The "8o" opening the last paragraph is copied as printed and may be a printing sign.
